device.description: 12-bit 200 kHz micropower sampling SAR ADC with synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7816.pdf (SBAS061) p.2 specifications (VCC 4.5-5.25 V, VIH, straight binary), p.3 pin configuration and assignments, p.9 digital interface, Table I timing and Figure 1, p.10 data format

pages: p.2 (VCC 4.50-5.25 V, VIH 3 V to VCC+0.3 V, straight binary), p.3 (pin configuration: PDIP/SOIC/MSOP share one pinout; pin assignments), p.9 (serial interface text, Table I: tdDO 150 ns max, tdis 50 ns max, ten 100 ns max; Figure 1), p.10 (data format)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (12 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges (sample time 1.5-2.0 clocks), then the null bit, then B11..B0; after B0 the part repeats the result LSB-first and then tri-states (text) or outputs zeros (Figure 1 note) - for the 0 V code all those bits are zeros, so idle 0 covers it
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (200 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits
variants: ADS7816B/C (UB, UC, EB, EC) are higher linearity grades of the same part (same spec). ADS7817 (differential, two's complement) and ADS7822 (2.7 V) are separate devices with their own datasheets.
